svg.title: Zero observed failures still leaves statistical uncertainty

cc:Work.dc:title: Zero observed failures still leaves statistical uncertainty
cc:Work.dc:description: The bound follows by solving (1−q)^N = 0.05 for q when no failures are seen. Independent identical trials are assumed; drift and systematic bias are not included.
